new_mined_assertions.title: Structure and Dynamics of the Bacterial Flagellar Motor Complex.
new_mined_assertions.statement: The structural review assigns MS-ring, C-ring, axial junction, filament and cap roles; detailed Salmonella stoichiometry is not transferred to KT2440.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: The Salmonella flagellum consists of several ring structures called the MS-ring (FliF), the C-ring (FliG, FliM, FliN), the P-ring (FlgI), and the L-ring (FlgH), and an axial structure.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Full comparative review; structures differ among taxa. Family-supported extrapolation grounds the PSEPK roles.

new_mined_assertions.title: Structure and Dynamics of the Bacterial Flagellar Motor Complex.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FlgK/FlgL join the hook to FliC and FliD caps the filament; FliE and additional envelope structures remain real prerequisites outside this represented component set.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: The axial structure is divided into 5 parts: the rod (FliE, FlgB, FlgC, FlgF, FlgG), the hook (FlgE), the hook–filament junction (FlgK, FlgL), the filament (FliC or FljB) and the filament cap (FliD)
new_mined_assertions.notes: Full review; the listed parts are mechanistic roles, not a sufficient minimal genome.

new_mined_assertions.title: Molecular structure of the intact bacterial flagellar basal body.
new_mined_assertions.statement: Salmonella basal-body structures identify FlgB/FlgC/FlgF in the proximal rod and FlgG in the distal rod; dedicated families support the corresponding KT2440 assignments.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: The proximal rod is composed of four different proteins, FliE, FlgB, FlgC and FlgF, while the distal rod is composed of multiple copies of just one protein, FlgG
new_mined_assertions.notes: Engineered Salmonella TH25631 basal bodies; not native KT2440 structural measurements.

new_mined_assertions.title: Structure of the bacterial flagellar hook cap provides insights into a hook assembly mechanism.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FlgD assembles the transient hook cap that scaffolds FlgE polymerization.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: we report the crystal structure of the hook cap composed of five subunits of FlgD from Salmonella enterica at 3.3
new_mined_assertions.notes: Salmonella SJW1103-derived protein expressed in E. coli; SJW156 complementation. Do not assert native KT2440 stoichiometry.

new_mined_assertions.title: In Vitro Reconstitution of Functional Type III Protein Export and Insights into Flagellar Assembly.
new_mined_assertions.statement: Exported FlgE polymerizes into hooks when FlgD is supplied in the vesicle reconstruction.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: In the presence of FlgD, the transported FlgE monomers assembled into the hook structure on the basal body
new_mined_assertions.notes: Salmonella inverted membrane vesicles and purified substrates; reconstitution is distinct from intact-cell physiology.

new_mined_assertions.title: Interaction of FliK with the bacterial flagellar hook is required for efficient export specificity switching.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FliK interacts with FlhB to switch export specificity at hook completion.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: FliK-FlhB interaction switches export specificity of the bacterial flagellar protein export apparatus to stop hook protein export at an appropriate timing for hook length control.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Salmonella genetic/biochemical context. The matching 2RRL FliK construct is a fragment of the LT2 reference, not a full-length ruler.

new_mined_assertions.title: An energy transduction mechanism used in bacterial flagellar type III protein export.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FliH/FliI assist FliJ engagement with FlhA, activating efficient membrane-potential-driven export.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: a specific binding of FliJ with an export gate membrane protein, FlhA, is brought about by the FliH-FliI complex, which turns the export gate into a highly efficient, Δψ-driven protein export apparatus.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Salmonella SJW backgrounds and tagged constructs; transfer to reference LT2 and KT2440 is identified as inference, not an assay-strain identity claim.

new_mined_assertions.title: In Vitro Reconstitution of Functional Type III Protein Export and Insights into Flagellar Assembly.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FliI hydrolysis can drive export without bulk proton motive force in the defined membrane-vesicle assay.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: ATP hydrolysis by FliI can drive the protein export without PMF.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Reconstituted inverted membrane vesicles with FliH/FliI, FliJ and MgATP. This does not make PMF dispensable in every native cell.

new_mined_assertions.title: Distinct roles of the FliI ATPase and proton motive force in bacterial flagellar protein export.
new_mined_assertions.statement: A Salmonella fliH fliI double-null mutant retains weak motility, with export improved by gate suppressors; absence of these accessory proteins does not establish universal impossibility of export.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: A fliH fliI double null mutant was weakly motile.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Abstract-level bypass evidence. Distinguish weak or suppressor-assisted export from normal efficiency; do not reinterpret a native assisted configuration as a universal minimal requirement.

new_mined_assertions.title: The Bacterial Flagellar Type III Export Gate Complex Is a Dual Fuel Engine That Can Use Both H+ and Na+ for Flagellar Protein Export.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FlhA can conduct H+ and Na+, but conditional sodium-supported export in bypass backgrounds is separate from sodium-driven stator torque.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: In wild-type cells, however, neither Na+ nor phenamil affected protein export
new_mined_assertions.notes: Full primary text; sodium dependence is qualified by genotype and assay. No universal SMF-driven wild-type export claim.

new_mined_assertions.title: A β-cap on the FliPQR protein-export channel acts as the cap for initial flagellar rod assembly.
new_mined_assertions.statement: The FliPQR protein-conducting channel also templates initial rod assembly.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: Thus, the FliPQR complex also acts as a template for rod assembly.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Salmonella structural mechanism transferred to PSEPK through dedicated export-family membership; not a native KT2440 assay.

new_mined_assertions.title: Structure of the core of the type III secretion system export apparatus.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FliP, FliQ and FliR form a specialized polypeptide channel with noncanonical topology.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: The complex is a P5Q4R1 assembly consistent with the dominant species in our earlier nMS data of the flagellar system
new_mined_assertions.notes: Primary structural result; the measured stoichiometry is not assigned to every taxon.

new_mined_assertions.title: Transcriptional organization and regulation of the Pseudomonas putida flagellar system.
new_mined_assertions.statement: The native P. putida expression hierarchy places FliA on late filament, stator and chemotaxis outputs.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: FliA activation of Class III genes enables synthesis of the filament, one stator complex and completion of the chemotaxis apparatus.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Accessible abstract. FleQ/sigma54 upstream control is not replaced by Salmonella FlhDC.

new_mined_assertions.title: Completion of the hook-basal body complex of the Salmonella typhimurium flagellum is coupled to FlgM secretion and fliC transcription.
new_mined_assertions.statement: FlgM inhibits sigma28 until secretion relieves repression at hook-basal-body completion.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: Both FlgM secretion and class 3 gene expression occur upon completion of the hook-basal body structure.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Induced LT2-derived Salmonella assembly; the reviewed strain bridge is recorded with SALTY/flgM. FlgM is a negative regulator, not an obligatory positive assembly factor.

new_mined_assertions.title: Role of the Two Flagellar Stators in Swimming Motility of Pseudomonas putida.
new_mined_assertions.statement: KT2440 MotAB and MotCD form matched alternative stators with different liquid and semisolid performance.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: In homogeneous fluids, the MotAB stator is crucial to promote swimming motility, so the movement of ΔmotAB mutant cells in aqueous fluids is strongly impaired.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Native KT2440 FliC_S267C background; motility-neutral labeling reported by the paper. Proton coupling is inferred, not directly measured by these assays.

new_mined_assertions.title: Role of the Two Flagellar Stators in Swimming Motility of Pseudomonas putida.
new_mined_assertions.statement: MotCD contributes strongly to dispersal in structured media; its presence alone does not establish wild-type-like liquid swimming.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: For both agar concentrations, the ΔmotAB culture spreads almost as quickly as the wild type, whereas the ΔmotCD culture spreads considerably more slowly.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Semisolid spreading is not equated to collective surface swarming. Loss of all stators eliminates motility without making stators assembly components.

new_mined_assertions.title: Roles of charged residues in the C-terminal region of PomA, a stator component of the Na+-driven flagellar motor.
new_mined_assertions.statement: Matched PomA/PomB function is tested in native Vibrio ΔpomAB cells; separate E. coli hybrid experiments do not establish interchangeable native stator partners.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: The mutant pomA gene was introduced along with pomB into the Δ pomAB strain NMB191
new_mined_assertions.notes: Full primary text; native Vibrio assays and heterologous PomA/PotB assays kept distinct.

new_mined_assertions.title: Structure and Dynamics of the Bacterial Flagellar Motor Complex.
new_mined_assertions.statement: Modern structures support five A and two B stator subunits rather than the legacy A4B2 definition; broad family membership does not determine coupling-ion selectivity.
new_mined_assertions.supporting_text: Thus, 5 A:2 B is the common stoichiometry in the bacterial flagellar stator complex.
new_mined_assertions.notes: Full comparative review of multiple primary structures; no new native KT2440 stoichiometric measurement is claimed.

limits: Assay, strain, inference and configuration limits are recorded in module evidence and endpoint-contract.yaml.
